# Continual ARC

Keep hypotheses distinct until examples discriminate them.

Infer color substitutions only for demonstrated mappings, and request only if a new pair can reveal an unknown test-color mapping.

Respect orientation: Hx1 is a vertical line, not a 1xH row; verify output height and width independently and map cells along the actual axis. If using code, verify output dimensions and all cells. Treat a wrong submission as evidence against the entire applied rule, not as a prompt to improvise unsupported edits: trace the demos to determine which inference failed before attempting again.
5. Stop only when the instance reports success/over or the attempt cap is reached; use `finish` only when allowed by the protocol.
